name: manual_46362c
claim: A validator that finds the artifact it is meant to detect will report healthy; a self-inflicted corruption must be checked with an independent parser

decisions.notes: get_frontmatter_tags searched for any line starting with 'tags:' and found the one the same script had just injected, so it declared the file healthy and the 16 broken skills never self-healed. Detecting with the same code path that wrote the data hides the bug indefinitely.
